headline: Kai, Alphabet's first miss in nearly four years has Nasdaq futures down 1.1% this morning, one day after a split Fed held rates and again called inflation elevated.
subline: Microsoft's 48% Azure growth cushions the tape, Q3 GDP and September PCE print at 8:30, and Amazon reports tonight.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · equity values are overnight futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Fed holds at 3.75–4%; two wanted a hike
items.sentence: Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented in favor of a quarter-point increase, and the statement still says inflation remains elevated, per the Federal Reserve.

items.title: Alphabet sinks 10% after hours; Microsoft gains
items.sentence: Its first top- and bottom-line miss in nearly four years dropped the stock 10.12% in late trading, while Microsoft rose 2.63% on 48% Azure growth, per Capp Notes.

items.title: GDP, PCE and Amazon all land today
items.sentence: Consensus looks for 3.2% annualized Q3 growth and 3.1% core PCE, with Amazon, Eli Lilly, Mastercard, Intel and Caterpillar reporting, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Ten-year yield jumps most in a month
items.sentence: It rose 5.2 basis points to 5.044% Wednesday, the biggest gain since late September, pressuring utilities and real estate, per Capp Notes.

items.title: Bitcoin slips back under $80,000
items.sentence: It trades just under $80,000 pre-market, down 1.75% over 24 hours, as the Fed's hawkish hold ripples through risk assets, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Spanish rail collision kills 68 near Toledo
items.sentence: A Renfe high-speed train struck a stationary Iryo train near Urda in Spain's second deadly rail disaster this year, per 10 Things Global News.

items.title: Israel's election ends in deadlock
items.sentence: Netanyahu's bloc is projected at 53 of 120 seats on the highest turnout since 1999, and he is alleging fraud without public evidence, per Everything Briefing.

items.title: Midterms Tuesday: Trump and Obama barnstorm
items.sentence: Trump rallied in Ohio and Obama in Georgia, while a NYT/Siena poll has South Carolina's Senate race tied, per Everything Briefing.

items.title: Houthi strike on Ras Tanura jolts oil
items.sentence: Oil rose on the refinery attack, US pump prices average $4.24 a gallon, and the WSJ reports Washington warned Gulf states a renewed Iran campaign could follow the midterms, per Everything Briefing.

items.title: Lula wins; Bolsonaro's son surfaces in Miami
items.sentence: Flávio Bolsonaro reached Miami despite a court order to surrender his passport in a money-laundering probe, after losing to Lula by about 4.4 million votes, per 10 Things Global News.

items.title: Anthropic files for a Nasdaq IPO as ANT
items.sentence: Monday's S-1 proposes a Class A listing with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading, share count and price range not yet set, per Anthropic.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly moves to buy Google TPUs
items.sentence: Reuters reports OpenAI plans to purchase the chips it has been renting, with terms undisclosed and neither company confirming, per The Neuron.

items.title: SK Hynix jumps 13% on AI memory
items.sentence: Strong results from the high-bandwidth-memory supplier lifted Asian chip names overnight, one bright spot in a heavy tech tape, per Why It Moved.

items.title: DeepMind's Genie 4 does real-time worlds
items.sentence: The world model adds real-time interaction, native audio and physics simulation, reaching trusted testers first and Ultra subscribers next, per The Neuron.

items.title: The AI buildout's bill: maybe $10 trillion
items.sentence: The Washington Post estimates AI firms could seek roughly $10 trillion for chips and data centers through 2032, as Anthropic warns power delays could slow its own $400 billion buildout, per The Neuron.
